title: Scam message checker
summary: Paste a text, email or link and get an explained risk score, entirely in the browser.
ideas: Add a screenshot upload step that extracts text and runs the same checks
Add a 'family mode': generate a short warning to send to a vulnerable relative
Check bank-name look-alikes with a bigger list of brands and typo patterns
Build a weekly 'scam of the week' feed with a quiz for older users
guide: Pages: src/pages/Checker.jsx (input, risk gauge, highlighted evidence, recommended actions), src/pages/Learn.jsx (common scams with warning signs), src/pages/Reports.jsx (locally saved reports). The detection logic is pure and explainable in src/analyse.js: a list of rules, each with a weight, a plain-English reason and the matching text. Rules run in the browser only (private by design). Add rules there; keep every rule's explanation understandable to a non-expert.
